charts.title: HAT-P-30 b: orbits around HAT-P-30
charts.description: The orbits of HAT-P-30's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HAT-P-30 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Yalçınkaya et al. 2024 (2024MNRAS.530.2475Y), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname YALCINKAYA_ET_AL_2024): P 2.8106007 d

charts.title: HAT-P-30 b: its transit
charts.description: HAT-P-30 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (34, 61, 88) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 455135327, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 9-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
